headline: See your factory in the app, and run builders where you choose.
bullets: Sign in with GitHub at openwiz.dev/app to see what needs you, every spec's ticket graph and your agents at work.
Run builders by hand on your own computer (Claude Code or Codex) or boat.dev, or as an automatic fleet in CloudRoom.
Install OpenWiz's skills into the coding agents you already use; your own skills stay untouched.
Plug in any place that runs agents with a small driver, a template to copy and a five-check test kit.
Keep your CloudRoom loops as files that openwiz loop checks, plans and applies, with no always-on engine.
Removed: the local web view and the send, new and attachment commands; the app now lives on the web.
